name: Resource teaser grid
definition: Grid of article, guide and webinar cards with type labels and a filter, linking out to the full resource library.
bestUse: Content-led marketing pages and the bottom of product pages, to keep curious visitors reading.

demo.how: A few strong resources are teased with a type label, title and reading time, and a filter narrows them without leaving the page. Choose All, Guides, Webinars or Templates: the grid updates and the count says how many match. The full library is one link away. Titles are illustrative.
